items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: A one-page website is $499, a business website with 4–5 pages is $999, and online bookings or a store start from $1,499. You'll get a fixed price before any work begins.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A one-page website is usually ready in about a week. A business website takes around 2 to 4 weeks, mostly depending on how quickly we go back and forth on feedback.

items.question: Will I own my website?
items.answer: Yes. Once it's paid for, the website is yours, and your domain stays in your name. Care plans are optional, never required.

items.question: Can I make changes later?
items.answer: Of course. Care Plus includes up to an hour of changes every month, so you just send me what you'd like updated. Without a care plan, I'll quote small changes as they come up.

items.question: Will people find me on Google?
items.answer: Every site is set up with clear page titles, descriptions and a sitemap, and connected to Google Search Console at launch. Nobody can honestly promise a top spot, but your site will be built to give you a fair shot.

items.question: Do you only work with businesses in Charlottetown?
items.answer: Not at all. I'm based in Charlottetown and happy to meet in person around the Island, but video calls and email work just as well for businesses anywhere in Canada.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: A rough idea of what you want, plus any words, photos or logo you already have. It doesn't need to be polished. Tidying it up is part of my job.

items.question: Who will I be working with?
items.answer: Just me, Ankit. No hand-offs and no call centre. The person you talk to on day one is the person who builds your site.
